annotations.title: Design a digital chip in Verilog

description: Designs digital logic in Verilog from a plain description, such as a 4-bit counter, a traffic light state machine or a logic circuit for an FPGA. Writes the module and a step-by-step test, builds it with Yosys and runs the test on the built circuit, correcting it up to twice. "verified" means it built clean and every test step passed; the AI wrote the test too, so it is returned for checking. Returns the code, the test and a link that opens the design with its diagram and waveforms. Takes up to 4 minutes. Counts toward the daily design limit.

description.description: The digital circuit wanted, in plain words, such as "a 4-bit counter with enable and synchronous reset" (3 to 1,000 characters).
